title: Rejuvenation Recalls Deep Frame Mirrors Due to Laceration and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The glue on the back of the mirrors can fail causing the mirror to detach and fall out of the frame, posing laceration and injury hazards. Units: About 3,325.

title: TBD Liquids Recalls Liquid Nicotine Products Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: Liquid nicotine must be in special packaging as required by the Child Nicotine Poisoning Prevention Act (CNPPA). The packaging of the products is not child-resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed or touched by young children. Liquid nicotine is toxic if ingested or absorb

title: Real Flame Recalls Arroyo and Hideaway Wood Burning Fire Pits Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Crate and Barrel (Recall Alert)
summary: Wood stored under the unit can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700 (In addition, about 81 in Canada).

title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Ozone 500 Girls' and Boys' Elevate 24-Inch Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The rear shock spring on the bicycles can become stuck, creating a pinch point between the spring and the seat, posing a risk of injury, or causing the bicycles to stop unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 3,860.

title: Walgreens Recalls Disney Baby Winnie the Pooh Rattle Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The feet on the Winnie the Pooh rattle can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 54,000.

title: Canyon Furniture Recalls Creekside Children's Chests of Drawers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Rooms To Go (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or serious injuries to children. The chests do not comply with the performance requirements of the voluntary industry standard ASTM F2057-19. Units: About 1,200.

title: ECHO EGi-2300 Watt Generators Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Manufactured by TTI (Recall Alert)
summary: The unit can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 3,700.

title: LoHi Tech Recalls SOWTECH Espresso Machines Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The glass carafe can break while in use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,900.

title: One Twenty Clothing Company Recalls "Sovereign Athletic" Children's Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard
summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 140.

title: Children's Sleepwear Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively by Zoetop Business Co. Ltd. at www.SHEIN.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled sleepwear sets fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,320.

title: Generac Recalls Portable Generators Due to Finger Amputation and Crushing Hazards
summary: An unlocked handle can pinch consumers' fingers against the generator frame when the generator is moved, posing finger amputation and crushing hazards. Units: About 321,160 (In addition, 4,575 in Canada).

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Electric Mountain Bike Battery Packs Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Water can penetrate the seal around the LED control pad on the bicycle's lithium-ion battery pack and cause the battery to short circuit, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2,500.

title: Birkenstock USA Recalls Kids' Mogami Sandals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A plastic rivet can detach from the sandal's ankle strap, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 15,200 (in addition, about 27 pairs were sold in Canada).

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard; Manufactured by Tkala Fashion; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 6,000.

title: Facebook Technologies Recalls Removable Foam Facial Interfaces for Oculus Quest 2 Virtual Reality Headsets Due to Skin Irritation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The foam facial interfaces can cause facial skin irritation and reactions including rashes, swelling, burning, itching, hives, and bumps. Units: About 4 million (In addition, about 172,600 in Canada).

title: Bel Furniture Recalls Barrington 5-Drawer Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Bel Furniture (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or serious injuries to children. The chests do not comply with the performance requirements of the voluntary industry standard ASTM F2057-14. Units: About 90.

title: BRP Recalls Side-by-Side Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stock CVT air intake can become completely obstructed with snow causing the drive belt to overheat and break, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 34,400.

title: Polaris Recalls GENERAL Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The weld between the brake pedal pivot bracket and the EPS mounting bracket can separate, which can result in a loss of brake function, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,400 (In addition, about 130 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A raised edge on the machined surface of the turbocharger castings can result in an oil leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,700 (In addition, 90 units were sold in Canada) (Some of these vehicles were previously recalled in May 2021)..

title: American Outdoor Brands Recalls Caldwell Earmuffs with Rechargeable Lithium-Battery Packs Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The soldering within the lithium-battery pack housing can allow the wiring to detach and cause the unit to overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 13,740 (In addition, about 88 were sold in Canada).

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls One Stop Gardens 15,000 and 30,000 BTU Tank Top Propane Heaters Due to Burn Hazard
summary: In windy weather, the flame can be directed to the rear of the unit, which can melt the "tip switch" safety shut off feature at the rear of the heater. This poses a risk that the heater will not turn off if it tips over and poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 350,000.

title: Rite Aid Recalls Rechargeable Handheld Fans Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fan's lithium ion battery can overheat while charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,780.
